findings.title: Uncommitted platform runtime artifacts in working tree

evidence.observation: Repository working tree is dirty with uncommitted file 'platform_runtime'

proposed_action.description: Add platform_runtime to .gitignore or commit designated runtime metadata to maintain a clean git state

findings.expected_benefit: Ensures clean working directory and prevents untracked environment state divergence across deployments

findings.title: Virtual environment paths included in audit scanning scopes

evidence.observation: Filesystem audit includes site-packages files from core/infrastructure/vm-processing/.venv/lib/python3.12/site-packages, artificially inflating doc count (1890) and configuration file listings

proposed_action.description: Update audit collector ignore patterns to exclude .venv, venv, and site-packages directories from filesystem traversal

findings.expected_benefit: Provides accurate repository inventory statistics and eliminates third-party dependency noise in audit reports
